name: print-social-buen-fin-instagram-posts-black-with-flat-shopping-illustrations
title: 'El Buen Fin' Instagram pack on black with colourful flat illustrations of people shopping
whatItIs: Five black square posts for the Mexican 'Buen Fin' sale event, with a red shopping-bag logo, bold white and teal headlines in Spanish ('El Buen Fin: ¡Más por menos', 'Descuentos que conquistan'), flat illustrations of people in bright clothing carrying oversized shapes and bags, small clouds, dot grids and flower doodles.
whatItMeans: Festive and friendly; flat character illustrations on black make a retail sale event feel like a celebration.
techniques: Illustrate people interacting with oversized abstract shapes.
Keep a black base with bright, varied character colours.
Use small doodles (clouds, flowers, dots) as filler texture.

vocabulary.definition: People drawn with solid colours and minimal detail.
Small decorative marks used to fill empty space.
